identity: ONE original massive stone construct, the Covenant Bastion, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep the broad stocky articulated grey weathered stone golem with antique brass and gold edging and black mechanical elbow, hip and knee joints. It is HEADLESS: no head, neck, face or helmet; tall upright golden stone ridges like organ pipes rise from the centre of the shoulders, with one small cylindrical lantern tower glowing orange on top of each shoulder. ONE round glowing orange-gold core sits in the centre of the chest above brass rib-like trim. Two thick stone legs end in massive two-toed block feet. Exactly two arms and two legs. The screen-LEFT arm ends in a large segmented stone hand used as a bare fist; the screen-RIGHT arm bears ONE long pointed charcoal-grey kite shield with gold linework and a round gold boss. Preserve the headless shoulders, lantern towers, core, shield and massive proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full shoulder towers, shield, arms and feet within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, weapons, magic effects, particles, head or extra limbs; the core and lanterns keep only their small steady glow. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; do not morph the stone body or shield.

idle_h3_v1.action: A heavy, patient idle that loops. The stone torso shifts its weight slowly, the shoulders roll, the free stone hand opens, turns its palm up and closes again, and the shield arm settles the shield, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. Both feet stay planted. No walking and no attack.

move_h3_v1.action: Stomp in place through two complete reciprocal cycles with heavy deliberate steps. Alternate near and far legs through forward contact, weight loading, passing and lift; both stone knees articulate and each two-toed foot alternates taking weight and swinging. The torso stays centred for engine-driven travel. The free fist swings slightly and the shield stays in front of the body. Finish in the original gait phase.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE crushing punch toward screen right. Draw the free stone fist back and up beside the shoulder while the knees load, then lunge forward on the front leg and drive the fist straight out to full reach at screen right, then pull it back and settle into the original stance. One punch only; the shield stays on the screen-right arm.

hit_h3_v1.action: Start rocked back in a flinch, then recover completely. The massive torso rocks backward, the free arm swings out and the knees flex while the shield stays held, then the construct rebalances on both feet and returns to the same stance. Remain standing. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

defend_h3_v1.action: Bring the kite shield across in front of the body and crouch down behind it on bent stone knees, the free fist braced behind the shield, then hold the low covered guard on both planted feet. No attack and no return to the relaxed stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A commanding physical gesture. Raise the free stone hand high beside the shoulder towers with the palm open toward screen right, hold it there briefly while the shield stays in front, then lower the arm back to the original stance. A physical gesture only: no spell effect, beam or emitted light beyond the steady glow of the core and lanterns.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse continuously from standing: the stone knees buckle, the massive body sinks down onto the knees, then pitches forward and falls flat onto the ground, finishing lying motionless face down with the shoulder towers toward screen left, the free arm stretched out on the ground and the kite shield lying flat at screen right. The core's glow dims. No recovery, no breaking apart, no floating parts and no disappearing body.

defend_h3_v2.action: Slowly and heavily bring the kite shield across in front of the body while the stone knees bend step by step, lowering the massive body into a crouch behind the shield with the free fist braced behind it, then hold the low covered guard on both planted feet. No attack and no return to the relaxed stance. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

cast_h3_v2.action: A commanding physical gesture. Slowly raise the free stone hand high beside the shoulder towers with the palm open toward screen right, hold it there briefly while the shield stays in front, then slowly lower the arm back to the original stance. No spell, glow or aura. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

death_h3_v2.action: Collapse continuously from standing: the stone knees buckle, the massive body sinks down onto the knees, then slowly tips forward like a toppling statue, the free arm reaching down to the ground first, and settles flat, finishing lying motionless face down with the shoulder towers toward screen left, the free arm stretched out on the ground and the kite shield lying flat at screen right. No recovery, no breaking apart, no floating parts and no disappearing body. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.
